description: Activity "structured-reflection-protocol" from SF.Activities.makeSlides, stepped through stage by stage with three phones answering whatever it asks (notes, replies), Bo dropping on its first prompt, the teacher-entered learner in the room, journal.

data.title: Structured Reflection Protocol (Four-Corner)
data.text:
Got it — Create a new example and explain why it works.
Mostly understand — Solve one example, then check the step you are least sure about.
Getting there — Use the worked example with a partner. Explain each step.
Need help — Bring your first uncertain step to the teacher. Start with a labelled sketch.
